logical_identities.name: Accounting period
logical_identities.description: One fiscal accounting month used to close the ledger, company-operated restaurant P&L, royalties, rent, capital, and segment consolidation.

logical_identities.name: Beverage platform
logical_identities.description: A beverage lineup or brand platform, including energy drinks and the rest of the lineup.

logical_identities.name: Calendar day
logical_identities.description: One civil date on the McDonald's reporting calendar. The complete population is the calendar day dimension in this finance slice.

logical_identities.name: Capex project
logical_identities.description: One capital project classified as a new restaurant, a remodel, or restaurant technology.

logical_identities.name: Channel
logical_identities.description: How the guest ordered, including in restaurant, drive thru, kiosk, digital, and delivery.

logical_identities.name: Check
logical_identities.description: One commercial transaction ticket. Several guests can share one check.

logical_identities.name: Commodity
logical_identities.description: A restaurant supply commodity, including beef, chicken, and energy.

logical_identities.name: Company-operated restaurant P&L
logical_identities.description: One company-operated restaurant profit-and-loss result for one accounting period. Franchisee profit is a different population and is not this identity.

logical_identities.name: Segment consolidation
logical_identities.description: One consolidated finance result for an operating segment and accounting period. The segments in this fact are the U.S., international operated markets, and developmental license markets.

logical_identities.name: Cost element
logical_identities.description: One cost element used to classify food, paper, labor, occupancy, commodity cost, and G&A inside the ledger and company-operated P&L.

logical_identities.name: Country
logical_identities.description: A country in which McDonald's restaurants operate. The country population includes the United States, France, the United Kingdom, Australia, and China.

logical_identities.name: Currency
logical_identities.description: One currency in which McDonald's records a local amount or translates a segment result into the reporting currency.

logical_identities.name: Daypart
logical_identities.description: A serving period such as breakfast, lunch, afternoon, dinner, or late night.

logical_identities.name: Development project
logical_identities.description: A new-restaurant or remodel project in the development plan.

logical_identities.name: Distribution center
logical_identities.description: A distribution center that ships commodities to restaurants.

logical_identities.name: Franchisee
logical_identities.description: A franchisee that operates McDonald's restaurants, including a conventional franchisee and a developmental licensee.

logical_identities.name: GL account
logical_identities.description: One account in the McDonald's chart of accounts, including sales, restaurant costs, franchise royalty income, rent income, and G&A.

logical_identities.name: Guest visit
logical_identities.description: One guest occasion at a McDonald's restaurant. Traffic counts can exist without a closed check.

logical_identities.name: Income cohort
logical_identities.description: A guest income band used to compare lower-, middle-, and higher-income demand.

logical_identities.name: Journal line
logical_identities.description: One posted general-ledger journal line.

logical_identities.name: Kitchen asset
logical_identities.description: A kitchen equipment or layout standard used to reach taste and quality goals.

logical_identities.name: Legal entity
logical_identities.description: One McDonald's legal entity that keeps a book of record for journal activity, royalty and rent income, G&A, and franchisee support.

logical_identities.name: Loyalty member
logical_identities.description: A person enrolled in McDonald's loyalty.

logical_identities.name: Marketing campaign
logical_identities.description: A marketing effort, including its development process, tactic, and event tie-in.

logical_identities.name: Offer
logical_identities.description: A value offer iteration, including a meal discount, a sharp price point, or an everyday value meal.

logical_identities.name: Operator
logical_identities.description: The operator accountable for a restaurant, either a franchise operator or a company operator.

logical_identities.name: Ownership spell
logical_identities.description: One continuous interval during which a restaurant is company-operated or operated by one franchisee.

logical_identities.name: Product category
logical_identities.description: A menu grouping used for mix, including chicken, beef, and beverages.

logical_identities.name: Product
logical_identities.description: One sellable menu item, including food, beverages, and limited-time items.

logical_identities.name: Protein
logical_identities.description: The primary protein of a food item, including chicken and beef.

logical_identities.name: Remodel
logical_identities.description: One restaurant remodel, including its cost, kitchen and experience scope, and the split of company and franchisee funding.

logical_identities.name: Rent charge
logical_identities.description: One rent charge that records rent income from a franchisee.

logical_identities.name: Restaurant
logical_identities.description: A McDonald's restaurant site.

logical_identities.name: Royalty charge
logical_identities.description: One franchise royalty charge that records franchise royalty income.

logical_identities.name: Segment
logical_identities.description: A McDonald's reporting segment. The population is exactly united_states, international_operated, and developmental_license.

logical_identities.name: Supplier
logical_identities.description: A supplier of restaurant commodities or kitchen equipment.

logical_identities.name: Franchisee support payment
logical_identities.description: One company cash payment to a franchisee, including value co-investment and energy-cost support, with a start day and an end day.

logical_identities.name: Technology program
logical_identities.description: One named piece of the global restaurant technology stack, such as loyalty or the point-of-sale platform.
